note: Screens that render late (backlog D30; docs/adr/0033-a-held-rendered-no-ends-the-second-look-before-a-cheap-rung.md): the live golden's `ensure` group (scripts/truth/live-ensure.ts) runs ensure_state on them, the app's phase events its oracle. No targets, no form: no truth is captured of them. held-no: `ready` at once while it draws nothing (a bare tree, src/ui-tree/bare-tree.ts) for 3 s, then Text "Welcome" (lab.held-no.welcome) and Button "Continue" (lab.held-no.continue); Continue shows Text "Home" (lab.held-no.home). held-no-spinner: the same, with 4 s of an unlabelled spinner (SwiftUI's ProgressView, Compose's CircularProgressIndicator) between the bare phase and Welcome; its ids lab.held-no-spinner.<tag>. Every phase change is an event (`phase`, `bare` / `spinner` / `welcome` / `home`), Continue's press a `tap` `continue`. App files: AveriLab/Held.swift, Held.kt; built by the native apps only.
